text:
olivia_sales: Heads-up  Fintera wants a hosted API key for a 10-day POC. Requirements: TTL 240h, auto-rotate every 48h, IP allowlist 52.17.0.0/16, billing tag acct=fintera-poc, contact: security@fintera.com. Can infra provision an ephemeral key we can hand them?

sam_se: We usually provision via infra for combined IP allowlist + scheduled rotation + final revoke. Console can create but doesn't wire the automated rotate jobs. Do they want a single shared key or per-team keys?

olivia_sales: Single key is fine. Shared across integration team. POC end date 2026-01-15.

raj_infra: I can provision under project sales-pocs. Confirming params: ttl=240h, rotate=48h, ip=52.17.0.0/16, tags acct=fintera-poc, owner=security@fintera.com, approved-requesters list?

olivia_sales: Add nina_cs@redwood.ai and security@fintera.com as approved requesters for emergency rotates.

raj_infra: Running internal (no secret in chat):
```
rwdctl keys create \
  --project sales-pocs \
  --ttl 240h \
  --rotate 48h \
  --ip-allowlist 52.17.0.0/16 \
  --tags acct=fintera-poc \
  --owner security@fintera.com \
  --requesters security@fintera.com,nina_cs@redwood.ai
```
Will schedule rotation and revoke at TTL.

authbot: key created (masked id rwd_key_q1w). resource id: key-6620. Rotations: 48h. Expires in 10 days. Audit: created by raj_infra at 1965023511. :lock:

nina_cs: I'll draft the handoff doc: include masked vault path, audit link, and the compromise playbook. Olivia, do you want me to include suggested client fallback behavior for zero-downtime swaps?

olivia_sales: Yes please. Customer asked how to rotate without downtime.

sam_se: Playbook we give: 1) Create replacement key: `rwdctl keys create --parent key-6620 --ttl 240h --ip-allowlist 52.17.0.0/16 --tags acct=fintera-poc --rotate 48h` 2) Add new key to server accept-list, let clients switch, then revoke old with `rwdctl keys revoke key-6620`. For immediate revoke, infra can revoke and issue new key in ~5-10 mins.

raj_infra: Note: hosted keys are scoped to hosted runtime. If they later request Dedicated or Private, we must create new environment-scoped credentials; hosted tokens cannot be promoted.

nina_cs: Vault path (masked): vault://projects/sales-pocs/keys/key-6620. Audit (internal): https://console.redwood.ai/audit/key-6620. Calendar revoke set for 2026-01-15.

olivia_sales: Thanks team. I'll send the POC handoff to Fintera with the masked path and the swap playbook.

raj_infra: One more operational note: if they want shorter live secrets, we can set rotate=24h instead; that increases ops churn. Confirm now or later?

olivia_sales: Keep 48h for now. If they ask, we'll discuss.

authbot: prov task closed: prov-11523. :white_check_mark:

olivia_sales: Great, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
